lines.text: Not as good as people say.
I think that cafe is overrated.

data.mean: Not as good as people say.
data.define: Used for something that gets more praise than it deserves.

example.text: I think that cafe is overrated.

misuse.text: Don't call her favorite band 'overrated' at her party.
